title: Community Solar Subscriptions - Waitlist, Allocation and Term Dates
content:
**Article 1 - The waitlist.** A household that subscribes to a share of a community solar project under Community Solar Subscriptions joins the project's waitlist. Waitlisted subscriptions receive project capacity in the order of the plan's waitlist basis, first come, first served by subscribe date; a subscription cannot be moved ahead of earlier subscribers by request.

**Article 2 - Allocation.** Allocation takes a subscription from waitlisted to active: project capacity is allocated to the subscriber and the utility begins applying solar bill credits to the subscriber's utility account. The allocation date is the date the utility accepted the allocation.

**Article 3 - Term dates.** On allocation the term begins on the allocation date. The term end date is the day before the same calendar day the plan's term in months later, using the last day of the month when that day does not exist. Plans without a term have an empty term end date.

**Article 4 - Leaving the waitlist.** A waitlisted customer may withdraw at any time without any fee. Withdrawal is the customer's own step out of the waitlist before any capacity is allocated, and the subscription then stands as withdrawn.

## Term end dates (hypothetical allocation dates)

| Allocation date | Term | Same calendar day, term later | Term end date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2025 | 12 months | 15 March 2026 | 14 March 2026 |
| 1 July 2024 | 60 months | 1 July 2029 | 30 June 2029 |
| 10 October 2025 | 120 months | 10 October 2035 | 9 October 2035 |
| 6 January 2025 | no term | - | empty |

## Points of reading

- *Can an earlier place on the waitlist be requested?* No. Order follows the subscribe date, and a request cannot move a subscription ahead of earlier subscribers.
- *Does the term start on the subscribe date?* No. The term begins on the allocation date, the date the utility accepted the allocation.
- *Is a fee charged for leaving the waitlist?* No. A waitlisted customer may withdraw at any time without any fee.
